description: This file defines an AuthProvider class for managing user authentication state within a Flutter application. It handles login, registration, session restoration, logout, and profile updates, interacting with shared preferences and an external AuthService.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages authentication state, including user login, registration, session persistence, and profile updates.

methods.name: restoreSession
methods.description: Attempts to restore a user's session from stored preferences.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts to log in a user with email and password.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears session data.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the local user profile with a new name.
